alternatives.name: OPTIONS_WHALE_EVENT_WITH_DIRECTION_AMBIGUITY
tradeoffs: Direction labels remain conservative; unusual calls are not automatically bullish whale trades.

negative: Direction remains ambiguous unless explicitly supported; liquidity gate failures must be surfaced.
positive: options family can surface entitled fixture activity without collapsing into a universal whale score.

decision.summary: Options whale events use whale_event payloads with family options, volume/OI normalization, liquidity_gate result, confirmation_score (DERIVED), and direction_label (supports_long|supports_short|neutral|ambiguous). PIT queries exclude events whose available_time exceeds prediction_cutoff. Unusual volume is not trader intent.
decision.title: Options whale envelope semantics and direction ambiguity

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: Acceptance authorizes fixture-first options on ADMITTED-OPTIONS-BIYA-001 only. Live Tradier adapters and option_chain entitlement require separate records.
